description: This file defines a helper class CatalogServiceHelper that provides static methods for filtering product descriptions by language and adjusting product availability based on locale.

classes.name: CatalogServiceHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manipulate product data for localization and availability filtering.

methods.name: setToLanguage
methods.description: Filters descriptions within a Product object to only include descriptions matching the specified language.

methods.name: setToAvailability
methods.description: Modifies a Product's availability set to include only relevant availabilities based on region, prioritizing default and locale-specific availability.
